symptoms.name: Fatigue
symptoms.description: Unusual and persistent tiredness common during breast cancer treatment; can impact daily functioning and may not get better with rest.

symptoms.name: Nausea
symptoms.description: Feeling sick to your stomach or vomiting often occurs with chemotherapy or targeted therapies and may affect appetite and hydration.

symptoms.name: Pain
symptoms.description: Pain or discomfort anywhere (surgical site, bones, joints, chest, etc.) that may be treatment related — track severity and location.

symptoms.name: Peripheral Neuropathy
symptoms.description: Tingling, numbness, or burning in hands/feet often caused by chemotherapy — track how it affects daily tasks.

symptoms.name: Appetite Changes
symptoms.description: Loss of appetite or changes in hunger levels; can be linked to nausea, taste changes, or other treatment effects.

symptoms.name: Sleep Disturbance / Insomnia
symptoms.description: Difficulty falling or staying asleep, or non-restorative sleep, which commonly co-occurs with fatigue and treatment stress.

symptoms.name: Mood Symptoms (Anxiety / Depression)
symptoms.description: Feelings of sadness, hopelessness, or anxiety that can result from and worsen treatment side effects; track daily changes.

symptoms.name: Cognitive Changes (Chemobrain)
symptoms.description: Problems with memory, concentration or thinking often reported during and after chemotherapy, useful to monitor over time.

symptoms.name: Skin Irritation / Radiation Dermatitis
symptoms.description: Redness, dryness, or peeling of skin in radiated areas or where topical treatment is applied.

symptoms.name: Swelling / Lymphedema
symptoms.description: Swelling of arms/hands following surgery or lymph node removal; track size changes and discomfort.

symptoms.name: Shortness of Breath
symptoms.description: New or worsening breathlessness can be due to anemia, cardiotoxicity, or lung effects; needs prompt reporting.
